sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 74 listed sites, read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park-camping ('40 full-hookup sites and 34 electric sites with 30 amp connections. Four of our full hookup sites offer 50 amp connections') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (Loop C/D 'Full Hookup' sites: Water Hookup Y, Sewer Hookup Y, Electricity 30 or 50; Loop A 'Electric' 30), read 2026-10-27

values.note: CPW counts 80 sites: 40 full hookup, 34 electric (30 amp), 6 basic. The booking site lists 74: Loop A 32 electric (27-65 ft, 13 pull-through), Loop B 6 basic (no vehicle length given), Loops C and D 36 full hookup (25-60 ft; all of C and half of D pull-through). Nearly all sites have shade shelters.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park-camping ('The Island Acres campground offers campers 80 campsites. There are 40 full-hookup sites and 34 electric sites ... 6 basic campsites that do not offer any electric') + brochure ('nearly all sites in Island Acres have shade shelters') + cpwshop campsiteDetails for the 74 listed sites (Site Type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Showers, laundry and flush restrooms are summer only; vault restrooms year-round.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park-island ('Campsite Amenities: ... Showers (summer only), Laundry (summer only), Playground, Dump station, Restrooms'; 'All flush restrooms, showers and laundry are shut down during the winter ... Water is available on a very limited basis. Vault restrooms are still available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: November through March only the electric and tent sites are open (full hookups closed); flush restrooms, showers and laundry shut and water very limited.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park-island ('The Island Acres section is open year-round for camping, but facilities are available in the winter (November through March) on a limited basis: Only electric and tent sites are available (full hook-up sites are closed). All flush restrooms, showers and laundry are shut down during the winter. Water is available on a very limited basis.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, from the day of arrival up to six months ahead; summer weekends fill fast. 14 days in a 28-day period at one park.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park/james-m-robb-colorado-river-state-park-island ('Camping at all state parks now requires a reservation. Reservations can be made the day you plan to arrive at the park or up to six months in advance. Weekends in summer fill-up fast'; 'Reservations can be made online, or by calling 1-800-244-5613'; 'visitors may camp for no more than 14 days in a 28 day period at a single park'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Electric sites $26 a night in January, $36 in June (a Saturday the same); full hookups $41 year-round on the booking site. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails with arrival dates Tue Jan 12, 2027 and Sat Jun 19, 2027 (Loop A Electric '$26.00' Jan / '$36.00' Jun; Loop C/D Full Hookup '$41.00' both; Loop B Basic '$26.00'), read 2026-10-27

note: In De Beque Canyon between I-70 and the Colorado River near Palisade, within walking distance of a swim beach and two stocked fishing ponds; the interstate and train tracks run alongside. --Claude
summary: CPW Island Acres + camping pages + brochure + every cpwshop site page: confirmed 80 sites, 50-amp (4 FHU sites)/water/sewer, showers, laundry, dump, year-round with FHU closed Nov-Mar, phone. Added max rig 65 ft, pull-through, flush/vault toilets and water, deep link, 180-day window, fcfs never, 14-night max. Fees 36/36 -> 26/36 (January electric $26) with the $5 full-hookup surcharge kept. Note: dropped the field restatements (counts, amps, amenities, winter FHU closure, reservable).
flags: Re-pin: stored 39.167,-108.3 (rounded) sits on the open ground south of Loop D by the pond's east shore, ~195 m from the centroid of the hookup loops; suggest 39.16875,-108.30015 (centroid of the 68 Loop A/C/D sites, between Loops A and D).

Waterfront lead (stored not waterfront): on Esri imagery Loop A's west and north rim sits ~50-80 m from the Colorado River behind a tree line, Loop B's six basic sites are closest to the river (~40 m, through trees), and Loop D's west row of points runs along the east shore of the larger stocked pond, ~20-40 m from the water. cpwshop marks no site 'Lakefront'. Worth a waterfront-gate look for a pondfront/view value on Loop D.
Count conflict: CPW's camping page says 80 sites (40 FHU, 34 electric, 6 basic); cpwshop lists 74 (36 FHU, 32 electric, 6 basic). Kept 80 as the operator's statement.
Season conflict: CPW says full-hookup sites close November-March, yet cpwshop sells Loop C/D full-hookup sites for Jan 12, 2027 at $41 with 'Status: Open year round.'
